title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for practicing with us again today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't mention it. We're glad we get to, since it's great practice for us too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The next time we have joint practice, you'll get to see us at the next level!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, the four of us are gonna polish our singing and dancing even more and really knock your socks off!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll see who knocks whose socks off!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but the next time you come see us won't be for joint practice. We'll be celebrating♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'll be back for Airi's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you going to have the usual birthday stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup. We've already got everything planned, so now we just need to rehearse and wait for the day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here's an idea. Why don't we leave a tablet here so you can all watch in real time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You don't mind? In that case, we could connect it to one of the stages' screens and have a viewing party.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A viewing party sounds great. We'll have to get some snacks and drinks ready too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, hey Airi. What kinds of segments do you have planned for your stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking back at funny or notable moments from our past streams, answering viewer questions live, all kinds of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've planned lots of segments our fans will really love, so expect to be impressed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like there'll be even more than I imagined! I'm so excited♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! Other than our viewing party, we also have to start preparing for Airi's birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: True. As far as the timing goes, I suppose after the stream would be best...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Airi, do you have any plans for your birthday besides the stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm, I am supposed to meet some friends. But other than that, I don't—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? I got a message from Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <Hello! I know this is out of the blue, but will you be at school on your birthday?>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <If it's alright with you, me and Emu were really hoping for some of your time during lunch break! What do you think?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like one more thing came up.
Airi's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're supposed to meet on the roof...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, Shizuku disappeared the moment our lunch break started. Was there something she—)
se_run_women_002_1
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Juniors
rows.Line:
Um, hello, Momoi!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Juniors
rows.Line:
We got you this birthday present!
We absolutely positively aren't going to miss your stream today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You even got me a present...! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I haven't been able to wait for today's stream either.
Let's have a great time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Juniors
rows.Line: Yeah!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina. What brings you to Class E?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was hoping for a chance to speak with you as well, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Momoi.
I don't have a gift like those girls did, though...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, just the thought is very touching! Thank you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By the way, I saw Tenma and Otori dashing up the stairs and saying they needed to get someplace before you arrived.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, yeah! We have plans to meet on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then, I shouldn't keep you.
Have lots of fun today, Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Asahina! It's my only birthday of the year, after all. I'll really savor it!
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late, you two!
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Airi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Are you surprised, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How could I not be? I knew Saki and Emu would be here, but not all the rest of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki told us she'd be celebrating with you, so we decided to tag along.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We put some dishes together for lunch, so please have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wow...! Look at all this food!
Okay, as the star of the day, I'll eat my fill!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This fried chicken is really good, Momoi. Here, have some.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I recommend the meatballs too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll have some of both.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair, you guys!
Airi, I recommend the potato salad!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This cheese wrapped in bacon is super duper delicious too, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll have some of those next, then.
And if anyone has other recommendations, I wanna hear those too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She really is today's star. Everybody's trying to talk to her!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa♪
One special chocolate cake, made by Emu and me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We used the recipe you showed us before, Airi☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, you two! I can tell just by looking that you made it with a lot of care!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna have to put all my heart into eating it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So... It's time for the technique!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What technique?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Is she gonna...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Time for a bite♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmmmm! My mouth is sooo happy right now♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow oh wow oh wooow!
It's Happy Everyday's Happy Snacker!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aaaaah! I can't believe I got to see it in person again! I'm so happy right now too...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh yeah. Apparently Kohane and An are preparing to celebrate too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Kohane and An? But they're on their trip to the US now, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right. That's why they'll be sending you a birthday message.
They told me to make sure you look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see! Well, I'll do just that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for all this, everyone. The lunch and the cake were both so delicious!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't mention it. We're glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm absolutely, 100% gonna be there for your stream today, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna watch it with Nene and everyone too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great, thank you! I'll go all out and make it a fun time!
